title: Towards a Measure of Individual Fairness for Deep Learning
reasoning: The paper's central contribution is a novel metric, 'prediction sensitivity,' designed to quantify and measure individual fairness in AI models. Fairness is a core ethical concept, and the paper is dedicated to operationalizing and evaluating this ethical principle in an algorithmic context. This goes beyond a superficial discussion of ethics and makes the evaluation of an ethical principle the main subject of the research.
